title: Pure Feral Imp
summary: Feral Imp is Yugi Muto's classic Level 4 DARK Fiend Normal Monster and its Flip counterpart, Des Feral Imp. Powered by Rescue Rabbit, Unexpected Dai, and Horn of the Unicorn/Horn of Light support alongside Level 4 extenders, the deck swarms Level 4 monsters to fuse into First of the Dragons, revive Feral Imp repeatedly via Daigusto Emeral, and command the board with versatile Rank 4 Xyz and Link monsters.

allow.Rescue Rabbit: Banishes itself to Special Summon 2 copies of the Level 4 Normal Monster Feral Imp directly from the Deck for an instant Rank 4 Xyz Summon or Link play.
allow.Unexpected Dai: Special Summons Feral Imp directly from the Deck while you control no monsters.
allow.Kagetokage: Level 4 Reptile that Special Summons itself when you Normal Summon Feral Imp or Des Feral Imp to immediately Xyz Summon Rank 4 monsters.
allow.Nefarious Archfiend Eater of Nefariousne: Level 4 EARTH Beast that Special Summons itself while you control a Spellcaster or Normal Monster to make Rank 4 Xyz plays alongside Feral Imp.
allow.Polymerization: Fuses 2 copies of the Normal Monster Feral Imp together to summon First of the Dragons.
allow.Dark Factory of Mass Production: Adds 2 copies of the Normal Monster Feral Imp from your GY back to your hand to refuel your field.
allow.First of the Dragons: Level 9 Fusion boss summoned using 2 Normal Monsters (Feral Imp) that cannot be destroyed by battle except with a Normal Monster and is unaffected by other monster effects.
allow.Daigusto Emeral: Rank 4 Xyz monster made with Level 4 monsters that detaches 1 material to Special Summon a Normal Monster (Feral Imp) from your GY, or shuffles 3 monsters from GY to draw 1 (1 copy, Limited in TCG).
allow.Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired T: Rank 4 Xyz monster that stalls the game by switching monsters to Defense Position and negating their activated effects.
allow.Tornado Dragon: Rank 4 Xyz monster that detaches 1 material as a Quick Effect to destroy a Spell/Trap on the field.
allow.Evilswarm Exciton Knight: Rank 4 Xyz monster that destroys all other cards on the field if your opponent has more total cards.
allow.Wee Witch's Apprentice: Link-2 DARK monster that boosts all DARK monsters (including Feral Imp and Des Feral Imp) by 500 ATK/DEF.
allow.Link Spider: Link-1 monster summoned using the Normal Monster Feral Imp to convert it into an Effect Monster for Link plays.

main: Feral Imp
Yugi's iconic Level 4 DARK Fiend Normal Monster with 1300 ATK / 1400 DEF that serves as the primary Rescue Rabbit / Unexpected Dai target.
Des Feral Imp
Level 4 DARK Reptile Flip evolution of Feral Imp (1600 ATK / 1800 DEF) that shuffles 1 card from your GY back into the Deck when flipped face-up.
Rescue Rabbit
Banishes itself to summon 2 copies of Feral Imp directly from the Deck to Xyz Summon Rank 4 monsters or Link climb.
Unexpected Dai
Special Summons Feral Imp directly from the Deck while you control no monsters.
Kagetokage
Level 4 DARK Reptile that Special Summons itself from the hand whenever you Normal Summon a Level 4 monster (Feral Imp or Des Feral Imp).
Nefarious Archfiend Eater of Nefariousness
Level 4 EARTH Beast that Special Summons itself while you control a Normal Monster or Spellcaster to make Rank 4 Xyz plays.
Horn of the Unicorn
Yugi's signature Equip Spell for Feral Imp in Duelist Kingdom that increases ATK and DEF by 700 (putting Feral Imp at 2000 ATK / 2100 DEF) and returns to the top of the Deck when sent to the GY.
Horn of Light
Companion Horn Equip Spell that increases DEF by 800.
Polymerization
Fuses 2 copies of Feral Imp into First of the Dragons.
Dark Factory of Mass Production
Adds 2 Normal Monsters (Feral Imp) from your GY back to your hand.
extra: Fusion boss made with 2 Normal Monsters (Feral Imp) that is immune to monster effects and battle destruction by Effect Monsters.
Limited to 1 in TCG: Rank 4 Xyz that detaches 1 material to Special Summon Feral Imp from the GY or recycle 3 monsters to draw 1 card.
Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired Tapir
Rank 4 stall boss that forces monsters into Defense Position and negates their activated effects.
Rank 4 board wipe when at a card disadvantage.
Link-2 DARK monster that boosts Feral Imp and Des Feral Imp by 500 ATK/DEF.
Link-1 summoned with Feral Imp to convert it into an Effect Monster.
